question.text: If a Restat setup was created due to an erroneous request from the BO, who must authorize the deletion of that setup?

explanation.text: The Logic: When a Restat setup has been created because of an erroneous request from the Beneficial Owner, the deletion of that setup must be authorised by the BO, ensuring that any change reverses the original instruction at the investor's direction. The Trap: The DP cannot delete the setup unilaterally, and the AMC/RTA or SEBI do not authorise such deletions. The authority rests with the BO whose request created the setup. Note: Stem reworded to attribute the erroneous request to the BO rather than describing an "erroneous deletion of setup".
